targets.descriptor: The all-over print is a photographic collage rather than a simple floral: pink and red blown roses sit over pale beige/grey ground panels that also carry faint monochrome photographic imagery and small runs of handwritten-style script, so the motif reads as overlapping printed 'pages' rather than a repeating botanical sprig. Solid near-black cloth is used as a framing device and follows the garment's construction lines — a narrow dark band runs the full length of the front placket, the collar reads dark on its outer fall, the deep sleeve-end bands are solid dark, and dark vertical zones run down the sides/underarm area, so the printed panels appear inset between dark edges. The body hangs with soft vertical folds and no visible bust or waist seaming, the front edges fall slightly forward of the form at the lower hem, and the sleeves widen gently just above the dark cuff bands, giving a slight bell over the wrist. The cloth is light enough that the display form reads faintly through the sleeve panels.
